review_execution_scope: Saved evidence document review only; no new scientific or numerical computation
intended_claim: Offline Critic scaling and composed-value loss improve calibration on calibration-held-out physical parents; Actor nonresponse has identifiable constraint/common-offset mechanisms. Route benefit unestablished.
what_results_support: Saved online Critic is strongly biased toward near-zero value predictions, underpredicts normalized L/K/H, and has remaining within-parent/state conditional error.
C1 and C2 improve held-out value MSE versus their own initial endpoints, final C0 and fitting-only global constants under both state_pooled and parent_equal aggregation.
C2 improves value MSE over matched C1 but beats the conditional constant only under parent_equal, not state_pooled, and worsens H-component calibration.
2426 multiple-legal states have strict base gap > 0.5; 6 single-legal states are separate. Actual residual state-equal energy is mostly common offset; 92 full rankings change but top1 changes zero.
what_results_dont_support: Route quality, full cost, planning time, unseen DRL-parent generalization, real IK/joint trajectory or robot benefit.
Uniform wins over the strongest conditional constant or improvement of every cost component.
Pure scale-only causal identification for C0 versus C1 because identical net tensors imply different initial physical predictions.
A fourth fitted configuration formed from mixed online checkpoint predictions.
A complete causal explanation of online failure, guard rejection, universal amplitude lock or automatic benefit from larger amplitude or more training.
missing_evidence: Physically matched initialization control and robustness across preregistered splits/initializations, with parent-cluster uncertainty.
Stable state-pooled superiority to the conditional constant and uniform component calibration; current evidence includes explicit failures.
A separately authorized online causal chain from a single Critic change through advantages and effective action changes to raw/H route cost and time.
A separate intervention testing common-offset suppression and useful ranking acquisition.
suggested_claim_revision: On 128 historical R03 trajectories from 50 physical parents, a preregistered 33/17 complete-parent offline split shows direct initial_n-normalized component parameterization improves fixed-budget Critic calibration. Adding composed-value loss further reduces held-out value MSE, surpassing a fit-only conditional constant under parent-equal but not state-pooled aggregation, while sacrificing H calibration. Actor saved-state evidence shows a strict residual-bound sufficient condition for about 30% of states and residual energy dominated by common offset, with some lower-rank changes but no top1 change. These are offline numerical/mechanism findings; online DRL route benefit is unestablished.
next_experiments_needed: None executed or authorized in this review.
Prepare only a C0-to-C1 direct initial_n-normalized output parameterization candidate protocol as the single priority change relative to R03.

If later separately approved, preregister physical-initialization controls, both aggregations, global and conditional fit-only constants, parent-cluster inference, same SL start/ON-OFF causal control, full raw/H cost/time and resource/stop rules before any online test.
C2 composed-value loss remains a separate future factor; do not label R03 C0-to-C2 a single-factor change.
Do not enlarge residual bound, add rounds, replace seeds/layouts or unseal original60/S3 to seek a positive result.
